title: Good-Sized Horse

{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Good-Sized Horse.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Zyle]] |location= Gerudo Canyon |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW| * Gold Rupee }} |previous= |next= }} {{Term/Store|Good-Sized Horse||Series, BotW}} is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Good-Sized Horse}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Gerudo Canyon}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== [[Link]] can begin this [[Side Quest]] by speaking to [[Zyle]], who can be found standing near a [[Cooking Pot]] in the [[Gerudo Canyon]]. Zyle tells Link that he was attacked by monsters,{{Cite|Yeah, so yeah, I'm a traveler like you... And I was attacked by monsters in this very canyon...|Zyle|BotW}} causing his [[Horse]] to run away and leaving him stranded.{{Cite|That's when my partner, that's to say, my {{Color BotW|Red|horse}}, ran off. And hey, I've been stranded here ever since...|Zyle|BotW}} Zyle asks Link to sell him a Horse for 300 [[Rupee]]s so that he may continue his travels.{{Cite|If, on your travels, you see a horse that would suit me, would you sell it to me for 100, no, {{Color BotW|Red|300 rupees}}?|Zyle|BotW}}{{Cite|Hey, yeah, if I just had a {{Color BotW|Red|horse}}, I could continue my travels, and you're a fellow traveler, so I have to ask, right?|Zyle|BotW}} When Link agrees to find him a Horse, Zyle's only request is that the Horse is not too big.{{Cite|Hey, thanks! But don't bring me {{Color BotW|Red|too big a horse}}... Won't be able to ride it! No, I need a {{Color BotW|Red|suitably sized horse}}!|Zyle|BotW}} To get a Horse for Zyle, Link must ride any [[Stable|unregistered Horse]] to his location and speak to him. A group of Horses can be found at the [[Gerudo Canyon Pass]]. Upon returning with a Horse, Zyle is excited that the Horse is just like his old one and asks if he could have it for 300 Rupees.{{Cite|Ohh! HEY! That {{Color BotW|Red|horse}}... It's just like my old partner! Talk about a fine {{Color BotW|Red|horse}}...|Zyle|BotW}}{{Cite|Think I could have this {{Color BotW|Red|horse}}? I'll pay you {{Color BotW|Red|300 rupees}} for it, what do you say, hey?|Zyle|BotW}} If Link agrees to sell the Horse, Zyle pays him 300 Rupees as promised.{{Cite|Hey, yeah thanks so much! Here's the {{Color BotW|Red|300 rupees}} I promised you as fair payment for this {{Color BotW|Red|horse}}!|Zyle|BotW}} Before departing, Zyle expresses excitement about his new partner and the Side Quest will be completed.{{Cite|Hey, hey! I'm making this {{Color BotW|Red|horse}} I bought from you my new partner! My new best buddy and traveling attendant!|Zyle|BotW}}{{Cite|So off we go, me and my partner! May we all have good travels!|Zyle|BotW}} ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | You ran into a traveler named Zyle on a road in the Gerudo region—he's in trouble after losing his horse on his journey.

He says he'll give you {{Color BotW|Red|300 rupees}} if you bring him a horse...but it has to be {{Color BotW|Red|appropriately sized}} for Zyle's body frame. |- | Complete | Zyle lost his horse during his travels and he seems to have approved of the one that you gave him to replace it.

You gave the horse to him for {{Color BotW|Red|300 rupees}}. }} ==Trivia== * There are three Horses that Zyle will reject. Whenever he denies a Horse, he asks Link to find him a "normal horse."{{Cite|Sorry to say this after all the nice horse-bringing you just did, but could you please find me a {{Color BotW|Red|normal horse}}?|Zyle|BotW}} ** If Link brings Zyle the [[Giant Horse]], he will refuse to take it due to its size.{{Cite|Hey, hey! You brought a {{Color BotW|Red|horse}}! But it's a little too big for me to ride...|Zyle|BotW}} ** If Link brings Zyle a [[Stalhorse]], he will refuse to take it due to it being scary.{{Cite|Hey, hey! You brought a {{Color BotW|Red|horse}}! But it's kind of really scary...|Zyle|BotW}} ** If Link brings Zyle the [[Lord of the Mountain]], he will refuse to take it since it is not a Horse.{{Cite|Hey, hey! You brought a {{Color BotW|Red|horse}}... Wait a sec! That's not a {{Color BotW|Red|horse}} at all! Bring me a {{Color BotW|Red|HORSE}}! Please!|Zyle|BotW}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Gerudo Canyon * Zyle }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
